targets.query: from(bucket: "hvac") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "hvac" and r._field =~ /^(outdoor|roof_out|house_return|house_supply|mass_out|core)$/) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
